extraction.name: EgoLife
extraction.description: A comprehensive 300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, and multimodal daily life dataset with intensive annotation, designed to advance long-term egocentric life assistance. The dataset features six participants living together for a week, recording approximately 8 hours of egocentric video and signals daily using Meta Aria glasses, along with synchronized third-person perspective data from 15 cameras and 2 mmWave devices. The dataset includes rich annotations such as audio transcriptions, visual-audio narrations, and EgoLifeQA, a suite of long-context, life-oriented question-answering tasks.
extraction.creator: The EgoLife Team
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The EgoLife dataset was collected over a seven-day period with six volunteers residing in a custom-designed environment called the EgoHouse. Each participant wore Meta Aria glasses and captured multimodal egocentric videos. To enhance the dataset with third-person perspectives, 15 strategically placed GoPro cameras recorded the participants' activities from multiple angles. Additionally, millimeter-wave radars provided spatial and motion data, supporting synchronized, comprehensive multimodal analysis of daily events and interactions. Participants were asked to organize an Earth Day party on the second-to-last day, engaging in activities such as meetings, rehearsals, cooking, and decorations. The primary language of the dataset is Chinese, with annotations primarily in Chinese and translated into English.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Physical data collection, Experiments, Web Scraping
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Meta Aria glasses for egocentric video and signals, 15 GoPro cameras for third-person perspectives, and 2 mmWave radars for spatial and motion data.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset underwent rigorous data cleaning to ensure synchronization, participant privacy, and readiness for annotation and data release. This included blurring faces and identifiers, muting sensitive audio segments, and reviewing frames containing sensitive screen content. Multimodal signal data (radar and WiFi) were extracted and aligned with video data for cohesive analysis. Multi-view synchronization was achieved using timestamps, and de-identification processes were applied to protect participant privacy.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotations included audio transcriptions, visual-audio narrations, and EgoLifeQA. Transcripts were generated using speech recognition and diarization algorithms, followed by human review for accuracy. Captioning involved splitting videos into 5-minute clips, slowing them to 0.8x speed, and using annotators to provide detailed narrations. These narrations were merged and expanded using GPT-4o to create 'visual-audio captions.' EgoLifeQA annotations involved generating 100K timestamped questions per participant using GPT-4o, which were refined by human annotators to create 500 high-quality questions per participant. Annotators also generated distractors for multiple-choice questions and specified the look-back time required for retrieving answers.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Video editing software with dubbing functions (CapCut), GPT-4o for initial Q&A generation, and human annotators for refinement.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The annotation process involved merging related phrases into coherent sentences, expanding captions with representative frames and transcripts, and verifying annotations through human review. For EgoLifeQA, AI-generated questions were filtered to retain only those requiring information from at least five minutes prior, ensuring long-context reasoning and practical relevance. Annotators also annotated whether audio was required to answer questions and specified the certification length necessary for retrieving correct answers.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Whisper Large v3 (for speech recognition), diarization algorithms, and video editing software (CapCut).
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is part of an ongoing project with plans to expand to cover a broader range of languages, locations, and activities. Future versions will include updates based on community feedback and additional data collection efforts.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Faces of participants and bystanders were blurred to anonymize identities. Sensitive audio segments containing private or potentially identifiable information were muted. Frames containing sensitive screen content, such as mobile or computer screens, were reviewed, and any private information was blurred.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset aims to advance egocentric AI assistants that can provide personalized, context-aware assistance in daily life, such as recalling past events, monitoring health habits, and offering recommendations. This technology has the potential to enhance human-AI interaction, particularly in personalized assistance and context-aware applications, improving quality of life for individuals needing consistent support.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset was collected in a controlled environment with six participants over a week, which may limit its generalizability to broader populations or longer timeframes. The primary language is Chinese, with a secondary English subset, which may introduce cultural and linguistic biases. The activities were centered around organizing an Earth Day party, which may not represent diverse daily life scenarios.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset is limited by its controlled setting and short duration (7 days), which may not capture the full complexity of real-world daily life. The primary language is Chinese, with limited English data, which may restrict its applicability in multilingual contexts. The dataset focuses on a specific set of activities (e.g., party preparation), which may not generalize to other scenarios. Additionally, the dataset includes sensitive information that has been anonymized, which may limit its use in certain research contexts.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning for egocentric AI assistants, long-context video-language models, and multimodal egocentric AI systems. The dataset is designed to support research in human behavior recognition, multimodal signal analysis, and human-machine interaction.
